test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is the tallest Victory tower in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fateh Burj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fateh Burj**

 
 
• The** Fateh Burj, the tallest minar in India**, is located in the Punjabi province's SAS Nagar district (Mohali district), near the old village of Chappar Chiri.
 
• In** 2011**, it was finished and inaugurated by the former Punjab chief minister **Parkash Singh Badal**.
 
• The village of Chappar Chiri is located along **National Highway 205A (India), also known as Banda Singh Bahadur Road**, which connects Kharar and Banur. 
 
• The tower, which stands at **328 feet (100 meters), is dedicated to the Sikh Misls**, which were established in **1711** and spread throughout most of Punjab.
 
• It is located just outside of Mohali, a short distance from** Landran and 20 kilometres from Sirhind**.
 
• Here, one of the most renowned **Sikh fighters, Banda Singh Bahadur, defeated the Mughal army's leader, Wazir Khan**, in a crucial conflict.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jhulta Minar**

 
 
• One of India's most well-known minars is** Jhulta Minar, located in Ahmedabad, Gujrat**.
 
• Because **both minarets shakes**, Jhulta Minar is sometimes referred to as a **shaking minaret**. 
 
• The mosque is thought to have been built in **1452 AD either by Sidi Bashir, a slave of Sultan Ahmed Shah, or by Malik Sarang**, another Sultan of Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **Qutub Minar**
 
 
• The **Qutub complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Delhi's Mehrauli area, contains the Qutub Minar**, a minaret or triumph tower.
 
• Qutub Minar is the **second-tallest landmark in Delhi**, standing at a height of **72.5 metres (238 feet)**.
 
• **Qutb Ud-Din-Aibak**, who founded the Delhi Sultanate after overthrowing Delhi's final Hindu ruler, **started constructing it in 1192 and finished it in 1193**.
 
 
 
• **Vijay Stambh**
 
 
• In** Chittor Fort in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India**, there is an impressive victory monument called the **Vijaya Stambha**.
 
• In **1448, the Hindu Rajput king Rana Kumbha of Mewar built the tower t**o mark his victory over Mahmud Khalji's army of Malwa in the Battle of Sarangpur. 
 
• The **Hindu God Vishnu** is honoured by the tower.
